answer: Lagoon Lottery Agent Admission. Each epoch, agents request entry nonces; a public beacon derived from a future threshold-signature round (unpredictable before it fires) maps nonces to slots in a fixed-size lagoon of active agents. Only drawn nonces act; duplicates collapse. An attacker must fund and run many live agents across epochs for a chance at slots, paying full compute and hosting per candidate with no precomputable hit—expected copper cost scales linearly with attempts while admission odds stay fixed. Unused nectar rewards roll forward, denying batch hoarding.
